name: Palm Plaza
summary: Palm Plaza is a 342,336-square-foot community shopping center located at a prime intersection off I-15 and Winchester Road in Temecula, California. The property features big-box retail, boutiques, restaurants, and a grocery store, serving an affluent trade area near the Promenade Mall.
demographics: Palm Plaza serves the affluent Temecula market with a median household income of $110,117 within a 1-mile radius and $119,400 within 10 miles. The trade area attracts middle to upper-middle-class families with an average household income of $128,444 nearby, reflecting the area's strong residential growth. The center draws from a substantial daytime population of 23,494 within 1 mile and 341,292 within 10 miles, indicating significant workforce and commuter traffic. Primary visitors are suburban families seeking convenient shopping for everyday needs, with strong representation from households earning $100,000-$200,000 annually.
description: Palm Plaza is a prominent 342,336-square-foot community shopping center strategically positioned at the prime intersection of I-15 and Winchester Road (State Highway 39) in Temecula, California. Located near the Promenade Mall, this well-established center serves as a convenient retail destination for the rapidly growing Temecula community and surrounding Riverside-San Bernardino-Ontario metro area. The property features ample parking with a ratio of 5.18 spaces per 1,000 square feet, ensuring easy access for shoppers. With its mix of big-box retailers, boutiques, restaurants, and a grocery store anchor, Palm Plaza caters to the daily shopping needs of an affluent trade area where median household incomes exceed $110,000. The center's excellent visibility and accessibility from major transportation corridors make it a go-to destination for both local residents and the substantial daytime workforce population in the area.
